text: Monstrous Macaws can be found flying within the Southsea Holdfast in the Thousand Needles.
__NOTOC__ Moon Priestess Maestra is a night elf quest giver located at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale. She is the namesake of Maestra's Post. During the Fourth War, she was targeted by the Horde.
__NOTOC__ Mooncleaver, Reborn is created with Blacksmithing (500); taught when creating Lunar Crescent, Reborn.
Moni Widdlesprock is a gnome located in the Trade District in Stormwind City. She can be found near the center of the district, conversing with Alyn Black.
Moonhee's Mean Vest is a possible drop from Ordos, the world boss yaungol on the Timeless Isle.
Moonfang Shroud gives the appearance of wearing a wolf helm, similar to Rok'nah Wolfstalker's Helm and Wolfshead Helm.
Monopoly: World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, made by USAopoly, debuted at the 109th annual Toy Fair on Sunday, February 12th, 2012 in New York City.

Mongrethod is a powerful annihilan responsible for the destruction of Xandros. He is summoned by and Teron'gor to dispose of intruding players in the quest Destination: Unknown. During the battle, Mongrethod is also confronted by and Lady Liadrin. While the former immobilizes him with the help of departed spirits, the latter obliterates him using a huge Light-based attack.
Moonlit Shore is a coastal area southwest of Karabor in . Many unbound water elementals roam the shoreline. The corpse of Enavra and her restless spirit may be encountered here.
Moonlit Note is looted from Disturbed Dirt while on the quest Silas' Secret Stash (quest).
Moonclaw's Sorrow was a quest reward from The Nightmare Lord.
Moon Guard Focusing Stone is a quest reward from Fate of the Guard.

The Moonfeather Prowler can be in eastern Suramar. These large silver-grey owlcats are commonly spread throughout the Crimson Thicket, sometimes sleeping or preying on the deer that share this habitat. Only hunters that know the secrets of taming feathermanes can catch one.
The Moongrasses are plants which appear around Legion Structures. They later also appeared on the Broken Shore and on Argus.
Moonfall Riding Hippogryph is a hippogryph located in Suramar.
Moonbeak is an owl located at the Eye of Azshara. It is the pet of Razen Swingblade.
__NOTOC__ Moonbark Ancients are Draenor ancients located in . They are fel-corrupted.
Moon Lily is a reward from Gathering the Dreamweavers: Celestine of the Harvest.
Monstrous Corpse Spiders are spiders located in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
Moonfall Manafiend is an arcane elemental located in Suramar.
Moonclaw Warriors are female worgen who join the Sentinels alongside Adella, Silvia and Tambre.
Moon Guard Remains are looted from Demonwaste Piles in Suramar.
Moon Guard Robes are a quest reward from Ravencrest's Legacy (quest).
Moonhazed Nightsabers are nightsabers located northeast of the Maw of the Void in Darkshore. These cats come in grey and black.
Mooncrazed Tidehunters are murloc attacking Glimmerspine in Darkshore.
Monstrous Pterrordax is a pterrordax located on a rock at the Shattered River on the border of Zuldazar and Nazmir. When crossing the nearby bridge, it flies away.

The Moonlight Ascent is a plateau above the Lost Temple on the Broken Shore. Entrance to the caves below is possible through a large chasm. Fel Tree Branches can be found here, one of them with a Rappel Point attatched.
Monstrous Behemoths are n'raqi located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Monstrous Azergem Crystalbacks are Azerite shale spiders who can be encountered on Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Moon Priestess Liara is a night elf ghost located at Zin-Azshari in Nazjatar.
Moonclaw is Huntress Arnithal's nightsaber located in Shepherd's Bluff in Stormsong Valley.
Moonlight Hunters are nightsabers located near Meredil in Suramar.
Monstrous Concoction is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Moonlit Katana was available through the Crate of Salvage and the Big Crate of Salvage.
Moona is a slyvern located at the Veiled Ossuary in Thaldraszus.
Moon-Kissed Feather was never made available. It is instead learned, as the Archdruid's Lunarwing Form, directly as a quest reward from You Can't Take the Sky from Me.
Moonlight Glaive is an appearance unlocked through the use of Traditionalist's Kaldorei Blades.
:For the post-Cataclysm replacement, see Grand Magus Doane. Morganth is a human warlock found in the Tower of Ilgalar in the Redridge Mountains.
More Magic and Mayhem is a sourcebook for the World of Warcraft RPG. It was published in 2005.

The Moonrage pack refers to the inhabitants of Pyrewood Village, which is located below the massive Shadowfang Keep. Originally simple, ordinary people of the kingdom of Gilneas, the townsfolk were cursed by the maddened archmage, Arugal. As part of their curse, possibly influenced by the Pyrewood Shackles they wear, the townsfolk turn into rampaging worgen at night.
Mooranta is a tauren artisan skinning trainer located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.
__NOTOC__ Moontouched Owlbeasts are owlbeasts found in the Hidden Grove, Dun Mandarr and Owl Wing Thicket in Winterspring.
Mor'rogal is a tauren quest giver located in Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.
The Moonrage Girdle drops from Hydromancer Thespia in the Steamvault in Coilfang Reservoir.
Moonsoul Crown can be crafted by jewelcrafters with a skill of 120.

Mordenaku, known in his high elven hunter guise as Mordenai, is a nether dragon quest giver located at Netherwing Fields in Shadowmoon Valley. During the invasion of Outland, he approached adventurers with a plea for aid to save his people from the Dragonmaw orcs. He is the son of Karynaku and Neltharaku, Netherwing's matriarch and patriarch, respectively.
Moonstone Wand is a quest reward from The Blackwood Corrupted.
Moren Riverbend is a tauren located in southern Nighthaven in Moonglade.
__NOTOC__ Moonrage Darksouls are worgen found in Silverpine Forest.
__NOTOC__ Moonrage Gluttons are worgen mobs found in Silverpine Forest.

Morgala Darksquall was a powerful naga siren. When Onyxia separated Varian Wrynn into two, Morgala and her naga attacked Onyxia. The black dragon and her dragonspawn fought against Morgala, and in the confusion of the battle, one of the Varians was caught by the naga while the other jumped into the sea; Morgala believed he would die in the sea but Varian managed to arrive at the coast of Durotar. The Varian they did catch was kidnapped and ransomed later. After some time, Morgala and her warriors attacked Varian "Lo'Gosh" Wrynn, Broll Bearmantle, and Valeera Sanguinar while they were traveling on the Wavecutter, Jaina Proudmoore's private vessel. At first, the naga myrmidon were losing again

Mord'rethar: The Death Gate is the first line of defense used by the Scourge in Icecrown. Its gate and walls are made almost entirely of saronite, near indestructible, and manned by massive Scourge constructs. Behind this gate lies the Valley of Lost Hope.
Mordan's Reagents is a reagent shop found on the upper level of the Trade Quarter in Undercity.
:Life, death, rebirth: all of nature is a cycle. Moonshadow is a night elf druid. She once fought Onyxia.
The Moonrage Armorer was a worgen found in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest. During the day, he appears in his human form as the Pyrewood Armorer.
Moonrage Elders are worgen found in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest. During the day, they appear as their human form as Pyrewood Elders.
The Moonrage Leatherworker was a worgen found in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest. During the day, she appears in her human form as Pyrewood Leatherworker.
The Moonrage Tailor was a worgen found in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest. During the day, he appears in his human form as the Pyrewood Tailor.
Moonrage Sentries are warriors located in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest during the night, appearing as worgens. During the day, they appear as their human form as Pyrewood Sentries.
Moonrage Watchers are worgen located in Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest during the night. During the day, they appear in their human form as Pyrewood Watchers.
Moontouched Wood can be found around Shadowfang Keep, and can be looted during the related quests.
Mordei the Earthrender is a rare satyr found patrolling at the moonwell in the Twin Colossals in Feralas.
Moonshell Crawlers are crabs located at Eventide Landing in .
More Like Wrecked-us is an achievement earned from killing Tectus in Highmaul by destroying all eight Motes of Tectus within 10 seconds of each other on Normal difficulty or higher.
Morfax is a draenei flight master located at The Draakorium in .
__NOTOC__ Morgo Kain is a ogre located at The Pit in Gorgrond. To defeat him, his Helmet must be destroyed first.
Moonshell Claw Bait is provided as an objective for Proving Your Worth (Alliance).
Moonshell Crab is a pet that can be caught during a pet battle in .

Moozy Waterwise is the infant son of Rordan and Sella Waterwise, initially found floating in a basket in the western part of Whitewater Wash in Highmountain. Rordan, who was injured in the battle with the drogbar, sends the player to find Moozy and bring him back to his mother. Moozy and his parents are later found in the Hammer's Cradle at Thunder Totem, with Moozy's basket hanging on Sella's back.
Morhun Rivertamer is a Highmountain tauren located in Suramar.
Moonshade Sanctum is a large building in Falanaar where the seed of the second Arcan'dor was kept. It is one of the largest structures on the Broken Isles.

__NOTOC__ Moonrest is a small wooded area in eastern Val'sharah, it contains Darkgrove Cavern. The Emerald Nightmare has tainted these woods. Lyrathos Darkgrove, a servant of Xavius has riddled this area with fel plants. Darkbinder Elissath can also be found here, attempting to resurrect night elven spirits and turn them into servants of the Burning Legion.
Moor Hens are chickens found at Marl's Stead and Bradensbrook in Val'sharah and Skyhorn in Highmountain.

The Moosehorn Hook is a bait item that can be fished up from open water in Stormheim and from Fevers of Stormrays, with an increased chance to be caught when using an Arcane Lure. It is also sold by Corbyn for . Using this item will enable the angler to catch the Silverscale Minnow, which serves as bait for the Thundering Stormray or Thundering Stormray (artifact power), depending on if the user has the Underlight Angler.

Mor'fani the Exile is a Zandalari troll who appears inside the ruined tower on a small unnamed island off the southern coast of Vol'dun while the world quest Mor'fani the Exile (quest) is available. A recent exile, he has been terrorizing the vulpera, and both Princess Talanji and Halford Wyrmbane ask that adventurers kill him.
Moonwood Bramblespire drops from Braedan Whitewall in Drustvar.
The Moonsong Doves are deceptive eagles located just off the road at the Path of the Light in .
Mordshell is a makrura who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
The Moonstone of Zin-Azshari can be obtained from Tortollan Trader's Stock.
Morgo's Unstoppable Ramming Helm drops from Morgo Kain at The Pit in Gorgrond.
A Mooring Line is found on the Moonspray in Darkshore during In Darkest Night.
Moonpriest's Vestments are looted from Sentinel Equipment Cache and Darkshore Cache.

Mord'al Eveningstar is a miniature Maw guard battle pet, awarded to players who earn the achievement Many, Many Things by unlocking every perk at the Box of Many Things in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Moonstalker Wristwraps are a quest reward from The Ritual Bond.
Mora Cloudwalker is a Highmountain tauren located at the Wild Coast in the Waking Shores. She is found sitting with Jaffe Cloudwalker.
Moonstone Pendants had the same effect as the Target Marker (item).
Moonshadow Stave is a quest reward from the druid quest A Better Ingredient.

Moroes is Karazhan's steward and was the butler of Medivh the Last Guardian. In life, he was a talented and loyal servant, though somber and somewhat paranoid due to the strange visions he received due to living within the walls of Karazhan. During World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade, he can be found as a boss, tending to guests in the Banquet Hall in Karazhan. It is later revealed that he is revived as an undead every time he is destroyed, though seems to be unaware of who- or what is responsible. He is aware of his undead state and of being mysteriously revived over and over. If he had his preference, he would like to die permanently, but makes do with continuing his steward work of kee
The Mosh'Ogg tribe of ogres live in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale. They are rumored to be in possession of a powerful stone that may be of use to the Horde.
Mot Dawnstrider is a tauren located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.

The Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound is an ogre mound inhabited by the Mosh'Ogg tribe of ogres located in Northern Stranglethorn, just south of Zul'Gurub. Deep inside the mound, their leader, the ogre mage Mai'Zoth holds a powerful relic called the Mind's Eye. During the war against the Zandalari, the place was overrun by Jungle Serpents and all the ogres were killed.

.]] .]] Mother Shahraz is a shivarra boss located in the Den of Mortal Delights in the Black Temple. Besides requiring high amounts of Shadow Resistance, the fight is rather basic tank and spank. All previous bosses (Shade of Akama, Teron Gorefiend, Reliquary of Souls, and Gurtogg Bloodboil) need to be killed before the door to Mother Shahraz opens. She must be killed before the raid can gain access to the Illidari Council. Given her location, quotes, and abilities, it can be surmised that she is the leader of the concubines in Black Temple and probably even a concubine herself.

Armorer, farmer, diplomat, weaponsmith, alchemist, healer. All of these professions are noble and have their places, but in these troubled post-war days, one craft has risen above the others in sheer profit margins: the mortician. Morticians do not go hungry. Undead populations always need replenishing with fresh troops, and graveyard raiding is a common job for undead minions. City and town guards devote precious time to protecting these plots, and some have even petitioned to bring the cemeteries inside the cities, which would take up valuable space and spread disease. Some morticians have seized this opportunity by hiring guards themselves and charging top dollar for "guaranteed safe rest

The Mosslight Pillar is located in northern Sholazar Basin. Like the Glimmering Pillar, Skyreach Pillar and Suntouched Pillar, it is a tall, narrow butt that rises up from the relatively flat basin floor, with a thin, elongated device hovering over it, swirling with magic. It sprouts with green crystals and quite a few ferns. The Oracles have a village not far from it which, according to Muradin Bronzebeard, is certainly due to the presence of the nearby titan Waygate. The Sparktouched Haven can also be found on its western base.

A mortal is a being who possesses mortality. Mortality is the condition of being mortal, or susceptible to death; the opposite of immortality. They include races such as orcs, humans, night elves (since the Battle of Mount Hyjal), dwarves, gnomes, draenei, blood elves, and goblins.
Morlia Doomwing is a Forsaken flight master located at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown. She will only appear once you have completed the quest The Shadow Vault (quest).
Morris's Order is provided for Supplying Brill and Ride to the Undercity.
The Morningstar of the Order is a quest reward from The Adept's Path.

__NOTOC__ Mostrasz is a red dragon in human guise at the Vermillion Redoubt, helping players to find the stolen black dragon egg. As he and a rogue adventurer infiltrated Ravenholdt Manor, they are both discovered. Wrathion commanded Mostrasz to deliver a message for the red dragonflight, that he is going to be free. Before leaving, Fahrad broke his legs. He alongside other Ravenholdt Attackers later attacked Ravenholdt Manor, but were killed by Ravenholdt Sentries. Mostrasz was killed by Wrathion himself.
Mother Sepestra is an imp mother appearing in the Black City during The Battle for Broken Shore (quest).
Mother Virila is an imp mother appearing in the Black City during The Battle for Broken Shore (quest).
Mostly Powerful Mojo drops from Stone Guardians in Un'Goro Crater.

Motoegg Tenders are mechanical spiders located on Mechagon Island.

__NOTOC__ Motorized Croakers are frogs found on Mechagon Island.
Mote of Blood Thirst is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mother Vishis is a venom spider located in Island Expeditions.
Mossy Hearthstone is provided by Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem for A Summons From Moonglade. It has one charge.
Motion Sick Peon's Magical Elixir is sold by Motion Sick Peon in Grimrail Depot and Motion Sick Peon's Soul in the Maw of Souls.
Motes of Magical Fire are controlled by Erugosa in the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken. They work over the Flame Kissed Meat in the oven.
Mote of Primal Energy drop from Primalists and empowered mobs during Tempest Unleashed.

Morqut Islet is an island found off the western shore of Forbidden Reach. Morqut Village is on the eastern side of the islet, and the Zskera Vaults are on the north. The islet is bordered by the Tempest Cove to the north, the Tempest Coast to Caldera of the Menders to the northeast, Aerie Chasm to the east, Sharpscale Coast of the Old Weyrn Grounds to the southeast, Talon's Watch to the south, and Sylvern's Roost to the west. The Irontide Raiders have set up a beachhead on the northern shore. The Morqut Ascent dragonriding race starts at just south of the village, and there's a Dormant Waygate at in the tower overlooking the village from the south. Inside the cave with a mouth at halfway up

Morqut Village serves as the quest hub and sanctuary of the max-level Forbidden Reach. Situated on the eastern shore of Morqut Islet, itself off the western shore of the greater Forbidden Reach, the village is bordered by the Tempest Cove to the north, the Tempest Coast of the Caldera of the Menders to the northeast, the Aerie Chasm to the east, and the Sharpscale Coast of the Old Weyrn Grounds to the southeast. On the islet itself, Zskera Vaults is northwest of the village. Renpiaq, the flight master, has connections to Wingrest Embassy in the Waking Shores, and the Veiled Ossuary in Thaldraszus.
The Moth-Pilfered Pouch is left behind by the Struggling Mothling after having learnt to fly at the Shimmering Towers in Zaralek Cavern.
Mountain giants are colossal creatures, crafted by the titans when the world was young.

World of Warcraft includes two default movement speeds, which can be toggled using the NUM PAD "/" button: # Run (7 yards or meters per second) – Considered the default move speed as all characters are created set to this speed. # Walk (2.5 yd or m/sec, 35.7% of run speed) – Confers no other in game effects, and hence only used for roleplaying or precision, such as positioning one's self without falling off a cliff. While walking is enabled, ground mounts and grounded flying mounts will move at walk speed too. *Takes 5.71 seconds to run 40 yards/40 meters at 100% speed, 40/5.71 = 7 yd/s. *Takes 16 seconds to walk 40 yards/40 meters, 40/16 = 2.5 yd/sec. *You will see yards or meters depending
Mountaineer Wellart Barleybrew is a dwarf quest giver located in the High Seat of Ironforge. Before the Cataclysm he was located in South Gate Outpost.

Mountaineer Thalos is a dwarf quest giver located at the Coldridge Valley entrance to Coldridge Pass in Dun Morogh. Thalos is tasked with warning off travelers who wish to cross through Coldridge Pass due to the trogg infestation. He directs those on business important enough to hazard these dangers to the next dwarven town on the road, Kharanos.

The Mouthpiece Mount is attached to the Maraudine War Horn, located on a tall butte at the northern end of the Valley of Spears in Desolace. Prior , the horn was reachable via a footpath and bridge. Since Cataclysm, the bridge has disappeared, making the horn only reachable by flying.

Mountain Skunks are skunks found in Grizzly Hills. As of the onset of the Cataclysm, they can now be found in various other locations as well, including but certainly not limited to Raptor Ridge in Wetlands; this is likely to allow players without the expansions to still work towards some of the Critter Love achievements.
Mountain o' Mounts is a collection achievement earned for learning how to summon 100 different mounts on a single character.
Mountaineer Kilian is a dwarf quest giver located in Prospector's Point in the Grizzly Hills. He helps with creating an iron dwarf disguise for the adventurer.

Mowed Down is a player vs. player achievement earned for destroying 10 vehicles and 100 players with the turrets in Isle of Conquest. The turrets referred to are the ones on top of the keep towers on the outer walls. Note that for this achievement, while you gain credit for killing players in the same fashion as for other achievements (participating is enough, you don't need to get the killing blow), you gain credit for vehicles only if your turret scores the kill.

Mount Hyjal is one of the two 80-82 level-up zones in Cataclysm. Breadcrumbs come from Stormwind and Orgrimmar from the Hero's Call and Warchief's Command billboards, which send players to Moonglade. There, the breadcrumb As Hyjal Burns directs players to the zone, where the chain proper starts underneath Nordrassil, the world tree, with Inciting the Elements and The Earth Rises. Hyjal is an extremely-phased directed-questing experience. Following the breadcrumbs from point A to point B will have players explore the zone in a relatively natural progression. The other 80-82 level-up zone is Vashj'ir. The quest chain of Vashj'ir also starts from the Hero's Call/Warchief's Command billboards an

A mule (also known as a bank character, bank toon, bank alt, or banker) is basically a mobile vault, a character that was created for additional item storage capacity. This type of character rarely gets played other than as a gopher between the character needing storage space and the merchants, supplies, and/or product(s), as in the case of a crafter, for instance. Other items typically stored on a mule are reputation tokens, consumables, cloth, and any other non-soulbound items of interest (e.g., ). Before patch 2.3, most guild banks were mules. Muiredon Battleforge is located in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward, in the dwarven city of Ironforge. Together with his friend Narm Faulk he had an encounter with some Dark Iron dwarves and barely escaped with his life. Worried about his friend, he sent a young paladin to save him.

Mulgris Deepriver is a tauren quest giver located in the small house at the Writhing Haunt in the Western Plaguelands. He was a member of the Cenarion Circle who was on the verge of death. Having failed to protect the native wildlife of the Western Plaguelands from the Scourge, he mustered what strength he had left to offer the player a chain of quests to cleanse the forest of the diseased and dying creatures. After Mulgris' death, the Cenarion Circle managed to partially heal the Plaguelands.
Muck Frenzies are frenzies found within a tunnel cave at Fray Island in the Barrens.

Near the windswept plains of Mulgore, there is a series of hot springs that house a ley line pattern. These hot springs have strange healing powers, allowing those who rest in them to heal at double their normal rate.
Mudrock Soup and Bugs could be the next big dish at inns in Stormwind City.

Mudsprocket is a goblin town in the south-west of Dustwallow Marsh. It is a quest hub with a flight master, inn, graveyard, anvil, forge and mailbox. This town's faction is tied with Gadgetzan and it contains a goblin laboratory.

Ueetay no Mueh'zala, also known as simply Mueh'zala or even Death, is an ancient and powerful loa of death worshiped by the Sandfury tribe. He was the master of the more amicable Bwonsamdi, but was cruel and bloodthirsty, believing that a god should rule, not beg for servants or worshipers. He was ultimately defeated by the Maw Walker and Bwonsamdi, who became his master.

Muffinmon is a jungle troll or gnome (depending on the race of the player) mage that is a part of the Uber Town group. He can be briefly seen during the flashback of the confrontation with Illidan Stormrage atop the Black Temple.

The Mucksnout Runt is a lone kobold found on a cliff in Darkfeather Valley overlooking Pinerock Basin in Highmountain, next to a treasure chest most notably containing the Delicate Roc Feather. If a player attempts to loot the treasure chest without first dealing with the runt, the kobold will attack them.
